'''Battle Station Command''' was a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] command unit of [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that oversaw the [[Battle Station Operations/Legends|Battle Station Operations]] branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], commanding siege weapons like the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]]. 

==History==
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] was appointed by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] as [[Chief of Staff/Legends|chief]] of Battle Station Operations in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].

[[Titus Klev]] was assigned to Battle Station Operations but only served in [[Siege platform/Legends|Dedicated Siege Platforms]] and orbital bases, rising through the ranks of Battle Station Command some time after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
